description: This file defines the class requirement_spec_mgr, which manages requirement specifications within a project management or testing framework. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, importing/exporting, and copying requirement specifications, along with handling custom fields, attachments, and requirements. The code interacts with a database and integrates with other components like requirement_mgr, cfield_mgr, and tree for hierarchical management.
